column1: # Deliberate differences between this pack and Yomitan's Ancient Greek processors at d3c54c1 (docs/languages.md 8.2), checked by tools/check-yomitan.mjs.

column7: Final_Sigma: JavaScript's toLowerCase writes ς for a Σ with a cased letter before it and none after it, skipping apostrophes, full stops, colons and the ano teleia. The pack's map (sources/case-maps.mjs) writes ς for a Σ at the end of the text or before a space or punctuation mark, so a Σ with no letter before it (Σ, Σ., Σ ν) gives ς, and one before an apostrophe or full stop with a letter after it (νΣ.α) gives ς where JavaScript gives σ.
